summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily buyback transaction reports provided to the ASX under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A and Class B shares. No new authorization or material terms were announced; the filing provides routine disclosure of repurchases and forward-looking statements. The company acts as issuer repurchasing its own stock, a capital return event. No board recommendation, advisors, premium, or close date are stated. Watch ongoing repurchase pace and remaining authorization capacity.
